UI Artist
to join our MONOPOLY GO! team in Barcelona (Spain) on a hybrid basis!
At Scopely, we care deeply about what we do and want to inspire play, every day - whether in our work environments alongside our talented colleagues, or through our deep connections with our communities of players. We are a global team of game lovers who are developing, publishing and innovating the mobile games industry, connecting millions of people around the world daily.
MONOPOLY GO! is a global phenomenon and the biggest mobile game launch in history, captivating millions of players worldwide. The team is based in Europe and the US and works daily to create captivating new experiences for our players.
UI Artist
Every Monopoly GO! season brings new experiences to life, and UI is where those experiences become clear, expressive, and unmistakably ours. As a UI Artist, you'll turn ideas into polished interfaces that balance visual appeal with intuitive design, helping every screen feel as good as it looks.
Getting that balance right means continually expanding how you approach the work. You'll build fluency with AI and emerging tools alongside strong UI fundamentals, learning where they can broaden exploration, improve iteration, and help you make stronger design decisions, with experienced artists around you to help develop your judgment and approach.
If you're looking for new design challenges, opportunities to broaden your visual and technical skills, and the support to turn strong fundamentals into a more confident and versatile craft, you'll find plenty of room to grow here.
What You Will Do
Create mockups and polished UI assets for Monopoly GO! features, translating flowcharts and wireframes into usable UI systems, with guidance from a Senior UI Artist.
Apply AI-assisted tools within your UI workflow, using sound judgment to identify where they improve quality, iteration, or efficiency.
Collaborate with game designers, UX designers, concept artists, animators, and engineers to keep the player experience consistent.
Present your UI work clearly within your immediate team, and advocate for strong UI craft.
Iterate quickly on feedback to keep your work polished and production-ready.
What We're Looking For
3+ years practical art/design experience in games, preferably mobile.
Demonstrated fluency with AI-assisted tools relevant to UI production, with experience applying them to real production tasks while maintaining quality.
Strong graphic design and illustration skills for casual/stylized games, with experience in typography and logo design.
Solid understanding of UI/UX best practices and interaction design fundamentals, backed by mastery of Photoshop, Illustrator, and Figma.
Strong cross-functional communication skills, with the ability to iterate toward the best
Bonus
Experience navigating brand guidelines and IP stewardship of at least one externally-licensed IP.
Unity experience.
A passion for mobile gaming.
Please ensure that the résumé/CV you attach is written in English.
At Scopely, we create games for everyone - and want to ensure that the people behind our games reflect that! jobs.description: As a Technical Lead – Network Programming, you will serve as the technical authority for multiplayer systems, network architecture, game replication, dedicated server technology, and online services. You will define the long-term technical strategy for networking systems while leading a team of programmers responsible for delivering performant, scalable, and secure multiplayer experiences. You will drive architectural decisions affecting millions of players, balancing gameplay requirements, server performance, scalability, reliability, security, and operational costs. You will collaborate closely with Gameplay, Engine, Online Services, Security, Data, Production, and Live Operations teams to ensure the online experience meets the highest standards of quality and competitiveness; aligning closely with Ubisoft's expectations that Technical Leads define technical vision, provide technical oversight, mentor teams, and act as trusted experts across the organization. What you'll do ### Technical Vision & Architecture - Define and own the networking architecture roadmap for current and future projects. - Establish long-term strategies for: - Game state replication - Server authority models - Client prediction and reconciliation - Lag compensation - Matchmaking integrations - Online infrastructure - Distributed game services - Make critical technical decisions regarding server architectures, networking frameworks, and backend integrations. - Evaluate technical trade-offs among latency, bandwidth, scalability, security, and development velocity. - Ensure networking systems remain scalable throughout the entire lifecycle of our live game. ### Multiplayer Systems Ownership - Own the architecture and evolution of: - Dedicated game servers - Replication systems - Session management - Matchmaking integrations - Backend service integrations - Cross-platform multiplayer functionality - Establish performance budgets and networking best practices. - Drive improvements to server stability, uptime, and operational efficiency. - Lead investigations into systemic online gameplay issues affecting player experience. - Ensure networking systems support future gameplay ambitions without major redesigns. ### Performance & Scalability - Define performance targets for: - Server tick rates - Bandwidth consumption - CPU utilization - Memory usage - Replication costs - Service response times - Analyze large-scale telemetry and production metrics. - Lead optimization initiatives for high-scale multiplayer environments. - Develop strategies to support player population growth and evolving infrastructure requirements. - Collaborate with Live Operations and Online Services groups to maintain service health. ### Reliability & Security - Establish standards for service resiliency and fault tolerance. - Drive initiatives to minimize service disruption and downtime. - Partner with security teams to address: - Exploits - Packet manipulation - Authority bypass attempts - Cheating vectors - Service abuse - Define secure networking practices across the project. - Participate in incident response and root cause analysis for large-scale production issues. ### Leadership & Mentorship - Lead and mentor network and online systems programmers. - Help engineers grow into senior and specialist roles. - Review architecture, designs, and code for technical excellence. - Foster a culture of ownership, accountability, and continuous learning. - Establish best practices and technical standards for multiplayer development. - Act as the primary escalation point for complex networking issues. ### Cross-Disciplinary Collaboration - Work closely with: - Gameplay Programming - Engine Programming - Quality Engineering - SRE / Operations - Backend Services - Data Engineering - Security - Production - Translate technical constraints into actionable recommendations for non-technical stakeholders. - Align multiplayer architecture with business, production, and player experience goals. - Coordinate networking initiatives across multiple teams and studios when required. What you bring to the team ### Required - 10+ years of professional software engineering experience. - 7+ years of experience developing multiplayer systems. - Proven experience leading technical initiatives for large-scale online games. - Deep expertise in: - Client/server architecture - Real-time networking - Replication models - Distributed systems - Concurrency and multithreading - Performance optimization - Very strong C++ expertise. - Experience with dedicated server development and operation. - Experience supporting live-service products in production. - Demonstrated ability to influence technical direction across multiple teams. ### Preferred - Experience shipping competitive multiplayer titles. - Experience with large-scale live-service architectures. - Experience building backend services and cloud-native systems. - Knowledge of AWS/Azure/Gamelift/Playfab, and service orchestration. - Experience with telemetry, observability, and production monitoring. - Experience working across multiple studios and global development organizations.

Our mission to build the future of commerce is real. We push the boundaries of what's possible to solve problems and break traditional tradeoffs. Join Coupang now to create an epic experience in this always-on, high-tech, and hyper-connected world.
Role Overview
Coupang is seeking a Director, Inventory Allocation and Control to lead a critical horizontal planning function that connects Retail growth, fulfillment operations, inventory governance, inbound planning, capacity management, and customer availability.
This leader will own end-to-end inventory planning policy and execution governance, including Days of Cover management, inbound planning, ordering controls, capacity alignment, peak event readiness, business review mechanisms, and planning automation. The role requires a senior planning leader who can make high-quality tradeoff decisions across growth, availability, capacity, working capital, and margin, while keeping customer experience at the center.
The ideal candidate will bring deep experience in retail planning, supply chain planning, S&OP, inventory management, or operations planning. They should be comfortable operating in a fast-paced, data-driven environment, influencing senior cross-functional stakeholders, and building scalable mechanisms that reduce manual work and improve planning quality. E-commerce experience is preferred but not required. Korean language ability is a plus.
What You Will Do
• Own end-to-end inventory planning policy, governance, and execution across short, medium, and long-term planning horizons.
• Lead DOC management, inbound planning, capacity alignment, ordering governance, and replenishment control mechanisms.
• Balance commercial growth, customer availability, fulfillment capacity, working capital, and margin outcomes through clear planning decisions.
• Partner cross-functionally to identify risks, resolve bottlenecks, and ensure inventory and inbound plans are operationally executable.
• Lead planning for major seasonal and holiday events, including buildup strategy, capacity readiness, vendor execution, and post-event learnings.
• Improve inbound planning accuracy, ordering discipline, and visibility into future operational constraints and availability risks.
• Build scalable mechanisms, dashboards, agents, and workflows that reduce manual work and improve planning quality.
• Own planning inputs for business reviews, annual planning, goal-setting, and executive-level operating discussions.
• Lead and develop a high-performing team responsible for horizontal inventory planning and inbound planning.
• Drive a culture of analytical decision-making, ownership, simplification, and cross-functional accountability.
Basic Qualifications
• Bachelor's degree in business, supply chain, engineering, operations, economics, analytics, or a related field
• 12+ years of experience in retail planning, supply chain planning, inventory management, S&OP, commercial operations, or operations planning
• 5+ years of people leadership experience, including managing senior managers, managers, or senior individual contributors
• Strong understanding of inventory planning, replenishment, inbound planning, capacity planning, and demand-supply tradeoffs
• Demonstrated ability to balance business growth, customer experience, operational constraints, and financial outcomes
• Proven ability to operate in a fast-paced, ambiguous, data-driven environment and influence senior cross-functional stakeholders
• Strong analytical judgment, business communication, and executive-level narrative-building skills
• Ability to build scalable mechanisms and improve operating processes, not just manage recurring execution
Preferred Qualifications
• Experience in e-commerce, retail, marketplace, consumer goods, logistics, distribution, or high-volume supply chain environments
• Experience working at the intersection of commercial teams and operations teams where availability, capacity, cost, and growth tradeoffs must be managed
• Experience leading S&OP, inventory control, inbound planning, ordering governance, or capacity management functions
• Experience building planning automation, control towers, dashboards, decision-support systems, or agent-based workflows

SpaceXAI’s mission is to create AI systems that can accurately understand the universe and aid humanity in its pursuit of knowledge.
Our team is small, highly motivated, and focused on engineering excellence. This organization is for individuals who appreciate challenging themselves and thrive on curiosity.

All employees are expected to have strong communication skills. They should be able to concisely and accurately share knowledge with their teammates.
ABOUT THE ROLE:
We are seeking a highly skilled Electrical Commissioning Technician to support the buildout and energization of SpaceXAI's high-performance data centers. In this critical hands-on role, you will perform commissioning, testing, and troubleshooting of electrical systems that power our next-generation AI supercomputing infrastructure.
You will work closely with construction, engineering, and operations teams to ensure safe, reliable, and high-quality electrical systems from initial installation through full system turnover. This is a full-time, onsite role with significant travel to SpaceXAI data center sites.
RESPONSIBILITIES:
Execute electrical commissioning activities for medium and low voltage power distribution systems, switchgear, transformers, UPS systems, generators, PDUs, and associated controls in data center environments.
Perform point-to-point wiring checks, functional testing, calibration, and system integration verification.
Troubleshoot and resolve electrical issues during pre-commissioning, commissioning, and startup phases.
Develop and execute detailed commissioning test procedures, scripts, and documentation in accordance with project specifications and industry standards.
Collaborate with EPC contractors, OEM vendors, and SpaceXAI engineers to coordinate energization sequences and integrated system testing.
Ensure strict adherence to safety protocols, LOTO procedures, and quality standards during all commissioning activities.
Maintain accurate as-built documentation, test records, and commissioning reports.
Support training of operations and maintenance teams on commissioned electrical systems.
Participate in constructability reviews and provide field feedback to improve design and installation quality.
BASIC QUALIFICATIONS:
3+ years of hands-on electrical commissioning or field technician experience in data centers, power plants, or large industrial facilities.
Strong working knowledge of electrical systems up to 480V (medium voltage experience preferred), including switchgear, motor control centers, variable frequency drives, and protective relaying.
Experience with commissioning test equipment (meggers, multimeters, relay test sets, power quality analyzers, etc.).
Familiarity with relevant codes and standards (NEC, NFPA 70E, IEEE, NETA).
Demonstrated ability to read and interpret electrical drawings, schematics, and one-line diagrams.
Strong safety mindset with current OSHA 10/30 or equivalent training.
Willingness to work extended hours, nights, and weekends during critical commissioning windows.
PREFERRED SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE:
Prior commissioning experience on hyperscale data center projects or mission-critical facilities.
NETA certification (Level II or higher) or equivalent (e.g., NICET, Journeyman Electrician license).
Experience with data center power infrastructure including redundant UPS, generators, and busway systems.
Knowledge of PLC/controls troubleshooting and SCADA systems.
Proficiency with commissioning management software (e.g., CxPro, Procore, or similar).
Technical degree or trade school certification in Electrical Engineering Technology or related field.
ADDITIONAL REQUIREMENTS:
Ability to travel extensively to SpaceXAI construction sites and remain onsite during peak commissioning phases.
Capability to work in industrial environments, climb ladders, lift moderate loads, and wear PPE for extended periods.
